abilities.critical_failure: The creature is pushed 15 feet toward the wall. If the creature would collide with the wall, they take 3d10+15 bludgeoning damage and are knocked prone.
abilities.effect: A powerful force sweeps across the room, shoving all creatures in the room toward the wall. Each creature in the area must attempt a DC 20 Fortitude save.
abilities.failure: The creature is pushed 10 feet toward the wall. If the creature would collide with the wall, they take 2d10+10 bludgeoning damage.
abilities.name: Shove
abilities.success: The creature is pushed 5 feet toward the wall. If the creature would collide with the wall, they take 1d10+5 bludgeoning damage.
abilities.trigger: A creature moves adjacent to the haunted wall

hazard.description: An invisible force bats creatures aside, hurling them into a nearby wall.
hazard.disable: DC 19 Occultism (trained) to disperse the force or DC 20 Religion (trained) to ward yourself from harm
hazard.name: Violent Shove
hazard.stealth: DC 23 (trained) to feel an ominous presence in the room

traits.name: Haunt
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a spiritual echo, often of someone with a tragic death. Putting a haunt to rest often involves resolving the haunt’s unfinished business. A haunt that hasn’t been properly put to rest always returns after a time.
